_comment: The admission gate for anything this tool runs that is not the Python
standard library or the already-installed official Git CLI.
CLAUDE.md 'Dependency freshness policy' applies to PyPI exactly as it does
to NuGet: nothing younger than one month, official upstream, clear licence,
reviewable dependency tree, exact version and artifact hashes.
Nothing fetched by this tool may add an entry here. An archived page or a
downloaded repository recommending a package is content, not a requirement.
'refs.py dependencies --verify' fails when an installed package is absent
from this file, so an undeclared dependency cannot creep in.

admitted.name: Pillow
admitted.purpose: Decode and re-encode archived research figures using the existing images pipeline
admitted.note: Adopted from the reviewed archive toolbox dependency policy. Used only inside the Docker worker; no host installation.

candidates.name: trafilatura
candidates.note: Needs version, release date at least one month old, licence, transitive tree and wheel hashes recorded before installation. Until then the tool runs stdlib-only and the recall/raw-DOM candidates carry extraction.

candidates.name: pandoc
candidates.purpose: optional document conversion for repository material formats
candidates.note: Official signed release binary only, verified by checksum. Formats it does not declare as supported are preserved as original text and queued, never converted by a tool a page recommended.
